Combat

Each round: roll initiative (1d6 per side), resolve morale, movement, missile fire, spells and hand-to-hand attacks in order. To hit, roll d20 and compare the result to the attack matrix using THAC0 and the target's descending AC; a natural 1 always misses and a natural 20 always hits. Damage is rolled after a hit, modified by Strength for melee weapons.

CategoryCheckSuccess
Attackd20 + bonuses≥ THAC0 - AC
Saving throwd20≥ saving throw target
Ability checkd20≤ ability score + bonus
Morale2d6≤ morale score
Turn undead2d6≥ table cell

Morale is checked when foes die or when the situation turns against them. Unarmed combat deals 1d2 or 1d3 damage; grappling, disarming and called shots are optional. Spells cast in combat follow their listed casting time and range.
